title: 1stDibs Announces Leadership Transition: Bradford Shellhammer to Become Chief Executive Officer, David Rosenblatt Transitions to Executive Chair, effective January 1, 2027
summary: NEW YORK, November 05, 2026--1stDibs.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: DIBS), a leading online marketplace for luxury design products, today announced a leadership transition plan. Bradford Shellhammer, the company’s Chief Product Officer and Chief Marketing Officer, will become Chief Executive Officer and a member of the company’s Board of Directors effective January 1, 2027. David Rosenblatt, who has served as Chief Executive Officer and Chair of the Board since 2011, will transition to Executive Chair.
